title: National Road Maintenance Services
summary: Provision of scheduled and emergency road maintenance services across key urban and provincial routes, including asphalt repair, drainage maintenance, and traffic management support.
requirements: Registered construction or civil works contractor
Evidence of experience in road maintenance projects of similar scale
Financial capability and appropriate equipment list
Ability to provide labor, traffic management, and site supervision

title: Digital Records Management Platform
summary: Design, implementation, and support of a digital records management platform for departmental document control, searchability, retention, and secure access workflows.
requirements: ICT service provider with enterprise software deployment experience
Compliance with data privacy and access control requirements
Host environment support and training capability
Demonstrated project delivery within government settings

title: Rural Health Clinic Supply Contract
summary: Supply of essential medical equipment and consumables to provincial rural clinics, including installation support and maintenance scheduling.
requirements: Proven track record for health sector procurement

title: School Building Renovation and Maintenance
summary: Renovation and maintenance services for selected educational facilities including classrooms, sanitation systems, and safety upgrades.
requirements: Construction company with civil and building maintenance experience
Resource mobilization plan for affected school sites
